## Documents cited

### `S1` — Édouard Dekeyser's 1946 Oostende remarriage act
- **URL:** <https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X9R6-DJNV>
- **Image:** <https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QHN-LQKQ-R48T-B>
- **Collection:** FamilySearch — Belgium, West Flanders, Civil Registration, 1582-1950 (Arr. Brugge, Burgerlijke Stand 1921-1950: Oostende, Huwelijkscertificaten 1946, akte nr. 81)
- **Via:** `familysearch`
- **Proves:** Édouard Dekeyser's parents = Desiderius De Keyser × Maria Theresia Van den Broeck; birthplace Hamme (Oost-Vlaanderen), b. 12 Nov 1876; first marriage to Louisa Maria Bocklandt ended in divorce (~1923, Rechtbank van eersten aanleg Brugge); remarried Leontine Schreel in Oostende 9 May 1946.
- **Local copy:** `docs/sources/edouard-dekeyser-1946-marriage-oostende.jpg`
- **Confidence:** doc
- **Accessed:** 2026-07-22
- **Note:** The wall-breaker. Read directly from the act image.

### `S2` — Jérôme Dekeyser's 1897 Oostende birth act (legitimization note)
- **URL:** <https://agatha.arch.be/nl/data/acts/GEWVL_GEBWVL_01442676>
- **Collection:** Rijksarchief AGATHA — Burgerlijke stand geboorteakten Oostende 1897, akte nr. 585
- **Via:** `agatha`
- **Proves:** Édouard × Louise married 4 May 1901 — the marginal note "Gewettigd 4 5 1901" legitimizes Jérôme (b. 14 Jun 1897) and Gustavus (b. 1899).
- **Confidence:** doc
- **Accessed:** 2026-07

### `S3` — Louise Bocklandt's ancestry (Bocklandt / Van Bergen, to 1768)
- **URL:** <https://gw.geneanet.org/wete1998?n=bocklandt>
- **Via:** `tree-wete1998`
- **Proves:** Louise Bocklandt (b. 31 Dec 1877 Hamme O-Vl) → Eduardus Bocklandt (1839) × Maria Louisa Van Bergen (1842-1888) → Antonius Dominicus Bocklandt (1805-1883) × Isabella Livia Ichau (1803-1870) → Daniel Bocklandt (1768-1837) × Philippa Van Puyenbroeck (1778-1820); and Van Bergen: Joannes Franciscus Van Bergen (1815-1898) × Ida Vermandel (1825-1865).
- **Confidence:** sup
- **Accessed:** 2026-07-22
- **Note:** sup for the ancestors, doc for Louise's own parents, which are independently on her AGATHA record.

### `S4` — Desiderius De Keyser × Maria Theresia Van den Broeck in Oost-Vlaanderen
- **URL:** <https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6TRG-9K8Z>
- **Collection:** FamilySearch — Belgium, East Flanders, Church and Civil Registration, 1541-1920

### `S5` — Zaventem Van Craenenbroeck trunk (to the 1830s)
- **URL:** <https://gw.geneanet.org/cisken?n=van+craenenbroeck>
- **Via:** `tree-cisken`
- **Proves:** Amandus Franciscus Van Craenenbroeck (1835-1914) × Paulina Mommaerts (1838-1909) → Antonius Josephus (1872-1936) × Anna Maria Meeus (1877-1957) → children b. 1902-1918 (Amandus, Paul Gustaaf, Melania, Arthur, Maurice, Bertha).
- **Confidence:** sup
- **Accessed:** 2026-07-22
- **Note:** Anna Van Craenenbroeck's specific parent among those children is NOT documented. Strong lead, not a link — it is deliberately not grafted.

## Archives

### `agatha` — Rijksarchief AGATHA — Belgian State Archives search robot
- **URL:** <https://agatha.arch.be/>
- **Covers:** Belgian civil registers and parish registers by commune and year, with scans. The primary route for 19th-century Belgian acts.
- **Access:** login
- **Note:** Post-1900 Oostende civil registers are NOT here — they are held at the Stadsarchief Oostende. Marriage acts are the richest single record: they name both spouses' parents.

### `search-arch` — Rijksarchief search portal
- **URL:** <https://search.arch.be/>
- **Covers:** Scanned civil registers by commune and year; the sibling portal to AGATHA.
- **Access:** login

### `stadsarchief-oostende` — Stadsarchief Oostende
- **Covers:** Oostende civil registers after 1900 — not in AGATHA and not digitised.
- **Access:** offline
- **Note:** Holds the two documents that would name Édouard Dekeyser's parents from Oostende's own registers: the 4 May 1901 marriage act and the 8 Sep 1951 death act. Death acts open after 50 years, so the 1951 one is public and is the cleanest ask.

## Record indexes

### `familysearch` — FamilySearch
- **URL:** <https://www.familysearch.org/>
- **Covers:** "Belgium, West Flanders, Civil Registration, 1582-1950" and "Belgium, East Flanders, Church and Civil Registration, 1541-1920" — deeper indexes than AGATHA or Ancestry, with act images.
- **Access:** login
- **Note:** Broke the Édouard Dekeyser wall that AGATHA and Ancestry could not. Try it before concluding a Belgian act is unindexed.

### `geneanet` — Geneanet — member trees and record index
- **URL:** <https://www.geneanet.org/>
- **Covers:** Member-submitted trees plus an indexed record collection. The member trees are the main lever for 19th-century frontiers.
- **Access:** mixed

### `ancestry` — Ancestry
- **URL:** <https://www.ancestry.com/>
- **Covers:** West-Vlaanderen and Brabant civil-registration indexes, searchable province-wide.
- **Access:** paywall

### `myheritage` — MyHeritage
- **URL:** <https://www.myheritage.com/>
- **Covers:** Indexed Belgian civil registration.
- **Access:** paywall
- **Note:** Login-walled in past passes; results were not reachable.

### `vrijwilligersrab` — Vrijwilligers RAB — marriage and death indexes
- **URL:** <https://www.vrijwilligersrab.be/>
- **Covers:** Volunteer transcriptions of West-Flemish marriage and death records.
- **Access:** open
- **Note:** Corrected Henricus Josephus Bostin's birth and death (Koekelare 1801 / Varsenare 1867).

### `vvf` — Familiekunde Vlaanderen (VVF) marriage indexes
- **Covers:** Flemish marriage indexes; the layer beneath several Geneanet trees.
- **Access:** mixed

## Obituaries & memorial cards

### `inmemoriam` — inmemoriam.be (Mediahuis)
- **URL:** <https://www.inmemoriam.be/>
- **Covers:** Digitised Belgian obituary notices.
- **Access:** open
- **Note:** Coverage gap: coastal and Brabant papers are poorly represented, so a post-2000 death on the coast may simply be absent.

### `ingedachten` — ingedachten.be / DELA
- **URL:** <https://www.ingedachten.be/>
- **Covers:** Funeral-home obituary notices.
- **Access:** open

### `uitvaart-oostende` — Uitvaart Oostende
- **URL:** <https://www.uitvaart-oostende.be/>
- **Covers:** Oostende funeral notices.
- **Access:** open

### `jammart` — jammart.be — doodsprentjes collection
- **URL:** <https://www.jammart.be/>
- **Covers:** Scanned memorial cards (bidprentjes), ~100,000 of them.
- **Access:** open
- **Note:** Memorial cards name parents and children and sit outside the civil-registration privacy rule, which makes them the key to 20th-century walls. Beware regional false positives — match on place, not surname.
